to: A (TRID-WORKSPACE-001: question-first retrieval over all registered material)

files.documents.jsonl: one row per document: collection, id, title, institution, institution_type, doc_type, applies_to, base_date, date_type, source_url, license, raw, raw_sha256, text_sha256, source_version, extractor, quality, table_check, pii_redactions, usage_restriction, training_status, search_status, nature, chars, passages, passages_dropped
files.passages.jsonl: passage_id (doc_id#start), doc_id, collection, start/end (character offsets into the document text of its source_version), heading_path, text, sha256, has_table, title, institution, base_date, source_url
files.dropped.jsonl: passages left out: evaluation_exposure (shared 20-char window with evaluation-side data, statute text excluded) or residual_identifier

rules_for_A: search use only: training_status is separate; nothing here is approved for training
show base_date/date_type with every answer; never call a value current (보수·수당·여비 값은 시점 값)
has_table or table_check=unverified: quote the passage and its source page/link; do not compute from table cells without showing them
usage_restriction rows (2026 보수인상률, future repeals): not a basis for a present-tense answer
public material from law.go.kr / data.go.kr and linked public providers; not institution-internal non-public data; do not label it so
evaluation items/answers: passages sharing text with evaluation-side data (148 signed reserved families included) are already removed; the 852 unsigned reserved families could not be checked
page_positions: not available in v2 (kordoc Markdown has no page markers); heading_path + character offsets only. PDF page mapping is follow-up work
excluded_upstream: held parts of every version (reserved overlap incl. 2026 보수 지침·예산편성 기준, OCR defects, table mismatches, deleted 별표, rights holds)
internal-rules v3 법령해석례/행정규칙 본문 (not in this batch)
raw 권익위 board rows outside the training view
